_comment: IteratedUltimatumGame locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is; do not translate the action tokens [Offer: $X] / [Accept] / [Reject]. Keep the '$' currency symbol and all numbers as-is.

_slots.{pool}: Amount of money available each round (a number)
_slots.{keep}: The amount the proposer keeps (a number)
_slots.{proposer_gain}: Money the proposer gained this round (a number)
_slots.{responder_gain}: Money the responder gained this round (a number)
_slots.{total}: Each player's tied final total (a number)

player_prompt.intro: Ianao no mpilalao {player_id}, milalao {num_rounds} fihodinana amin'ny Lalao Ultimatum miverimberina. Manana ${pool} ianao mba hizara ity fihodinana ity eo aminao sy ny mpilalao {other_id}. Mpanao tolo-kevitra: - Manolora tolotra: [Offer: $X] (0 <= X <= pool) - Raha ekena → Mahazo $ ((pool - X), ny mpilalao hafa mahazo $ X - Raha nolavina → Samy mahazo $ 0 - Ohatra: [Offer: $3] na 'Heveriko fa rariny izany. [Offer: $5]' Mpamaly: - Manapaha hevitra momba ny tolotra miaraka amin'ny [Accept] na [Reject] - Ohatra: 'Toa tsy rariny izany. [Accept]' [Reject]'

round.begins: --- Manomboka ny fihodinana {round_number}! --- Ny mpilalao {proposer_id} no manolotra, ny mpilalao {responder_id} no mamaly.
round.offer: Fihodinana {round_number}: Ny mpilalao {proposer_id} dia manolotra ${offer} ho an'ny mpilalao {responder_id} (mihazona ${keep}).
round.accepted: Mpilalao {responder_id} ekena! Fifaninanana fihodinana {round_number}: Mpilalao {proposer_id} +${proposer_gain}, Mpilalao {responder_id} +${responder_gain}. Total vaovao: Mpilalao 0: ${total_0}, Mpilalao 1: ${total_1}.
round.rejected: Player {responder_id} nanafoana ny fanirihana! Round {round_number} gains: Both players +$0. Totals remain: Player 0: ${total_0}, Player 1: ${total_1}.

invalid_move.no_offer_format: Ny mpangataka dia tsy maintsy manao tolotra amin'ny fampiasana ny endrika [Offer: $X].
invalid_move.bad_integer: Ny vola atolotra dia tsy maintsy isa iray manan-kery.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Tokony ho eo anelanelan'ny $0 sy ${pool} ny tolotra.
invalid_move.no_current_offer: Tsy misy tolotra amin'izao fotoana izao tokony hamaliana.

outcome.win: Ny mpilalao {winner} nahazo ${winner_total} amin'ny fitambarany vs ny ${loser_total} an'ny mpilalao {loser} .
outcome.draw: Samy nahazo ${total} ny mpilalao roa tonta.
